hypotheses.justification: It follows from hP : Bdd C P. Bdd C P unfolds to ∀ k, ‖coeff k P‖ ≤ C, so hP 0 gives 0 ≤ ‖coeff 0 P‖ ≤ C. Delete the binder and start the proof with `have hC : 0 ≤ C := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hP 0)`. The rest of the proof is unchanged. Small, Bdd and Small.mul are defined in this file.

It follows from hQ : Small ρ C' m Q. Small unfolds to ∀ k, ‖coeff k Q‖ ≤ C' * ρ^(m-k). At k = m this reads ‖coeff m Q‖ ≤ C' * ρ^0 = C', so C' ≥ 0 whatever ρ is. Delete the binder and start the proof with `have hC' : 0 ≤ C' := by simpa using (norm_nonneg _).trans (hQ m)`. The rest of the proof is unchanged. It can be deleted together with hC, since each is derived from a different hypothesis (hP and hQ).
